data.long_meaning: Vanditha is a Sanskrit and Tamil name derived from the word 'Vandana', meaning 'worship'. It is believed that the name Vanditha was given to the goddess of prosperity and abundance. It is a name that symbolizes wealth, prosperity, and abundance in all areas of life. The name Vanditha carries the meaning “Goddess of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil. Parents who choose Vanditha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
